wikiclone-desc: Populates the wiki on demand from Wikipedia: a pre-loaded title index keeps links blue, and articles are fetched the first time they are viewed.
wikiclone-branch-exists: There is already a branch called "$1".
wikiclone-branch-badname: A branch name may only use letters, digits, spaces, dots, hyphens and underscores, up to 64 characters.
